feeds.title: The TensorFlow Blog
feeds.description: The blog contains regular news from the TensorFlow team and the community, with articles on Python, TensorFlow.js, TF Lite, and TFX. TensorFlow is a fast, flexible, and scalable open-source machine-learning library for research and production.

feeds.title: RStudio » TensorFlow for R
feeds.description: RStudio is the Open source and enterprise-ready professional software for the R community. Follow this blog for news, insights, and in-depth case studies on the R interface to TensorFlow and Keras.
